dispatched_notes: 8 crews/aircraft: 100-01 ('8 crews total', 'could only put up 8 aircraft after the Munster Mission') and AAM mission summary '100BG (8)'. 0 aircraft and 0 crew lost, bombing result EXCELLENT, 7 enemy aircraft claimed, 100th mission no. 36 (100-03). The 100th's own report (100-02) says its aircraft flew in two group formations: low group of the wing formation (with 390th) and high group with the 95th. These are 100th BG aircraft flown by 100th crews inside other groups' formations; recorded here as 100th sorties, not in the 95th file.

aircraft.formation_position: Flew in the 100th BG composite formation attached to the 95th BG, reported as the 'high group with 95th' (100-02, 100-01). Hughes led the four 100th crews with the 95th (100-01, 100-04).
aircraft.notes: Aircraft NOT established. 100-01 captions the crew list 'The crew of Nine Little Yanks and A Jerk on 14 October 1944' (1944 is a typo for 1943). The 100th database record for 'Nine Little Yanks and a Jerk' (42-3271, 351st EP-L, 100-05) shows 'FTO - engine trouble 10 Oct 43', no 14 Oct 43 entry, and Hughes as pilot only from 5 Nov 43; so the name may identify the crew rather than the aircraft flown that day. Candidate 42-3271 is UNVERIFIED. Outcome 'bombed' inferred: 100th mission record gives bombing result EXCELLENT and 0 aircraft lost (100-03); no abort recorded for this crew.

aircraft.notes: Bombardier 2nd Lt Ruben C. Kelsey (Keel crew, 351st Sqdn Crew 25) wrote that on 14/10/43 they 'flew with the 95th BG' and 'flew Heaven Can Wait' (100-01). 100th database: 42-5997 'Heaven Can Wait', 351st, EP-F (100-06; later lost 30 Dec 1943, MACR 2019). Kelsey says he and the ball turret gunner were each credited with enemy fighters (his an FW 190). research_gaps: Serial numbers: only one aircraft serial is supported by evidence (42-5997 'Heaven Can Wait', by name in an eyewitness account). 42-3271 and 42-6087 are mentioned on 100-01 but contradicted by their own aircraft records; the remaining aircraft are unknown. Searched: 100thbg.com Black Week page, mission record 36 (mission_id=48) incl. photo album, aircraft database (by name), crew database, AAM.

Crew manifests: only the Hughes and Roane crews are tied to 14 Oct by a dated caption; all others are original crew rosters (UNVERIFIED). Lohof, Lakin and Mitchell crews are listed only by their position on the page.
Ranks on the date not established; rank_in_source is as printed on 100-01 (may be later ranks).
Formation slot within each composite group not found.
Squadron code for Roane (349th) and squadrons for Lohof and Lakin crews not established from sources consulted.
Recommended next sources: 100th BG loading list / sortie report for 14 Oct 1943 (AFHRA 100th BG collection or 13th CBW history), 390th BG and 95th BG formation charts for the day.
